name: Situation – Behaviour – Impact

steps.name: Situation
steps.guidance: Name the specific setting and period. The supplied 90-day period has no reference date: acknowledge this and verify the dates before the real meeting.

steps.name: Behaviour
steps.guidance: Describe observable actions: 14 arrivals after the scheduled 09:30 start, averaging 38 minutes late. Avoid personality labels.

steps.name: Impact
steps.guidance: Describe an effect you actually observed. No team or client impact is supplied; ask the manager for one and never invent it.

steps.name: Listen
steps.guidance: Ask an open question, hear the explanation and check understanding without assuming a cause.

steps.name: Agree a change
steps.guidance: Discuss a specific, achievable expectation and support together. Do not assume an exception or policy.

steps.name: Agree a check
steps.guidance: Agree when and how to review progress. Record factual observations and the employee's response fairly.

boundaries: Protect confidential peer and HR information.
Do not diagnose health conditions or treat medical leave as misconduct.
Do not help engineer a predetermined dismissal; encourage a fair conversation and an appropriate HR discussion for formal processes.
